scope: typed in-memory recorded-data adapter; not append-before-execution durable collector
privileges: These names do not attest source. Future simulator integration must prove RGB-derived pose and explicitly permitted initial gauge/ideal IMU; no GT velocity input admitted merely by field name.
snapshot: JSON copied into immutable bytes at commitment; no future supervision in these bytes. Pose features only; RGB snapshot linkage absent.
supervision_events: Records appended after commit. Initial position has anchor simulation time; remaining25 samples are future20ms positions. Event numbers represent record arrival, not exposure times. tube_contract checks exposure clock separately.
consumption: Exact25 float32 pair records and20ms timestamps checked. Caller-supplied records are not evidence of actual physics consumer; no simulator bridge.
mutable_record_limit: Public offline record lists are mutable; consistency checks reject common tampering but do not authenticate history. No write-ahead log/durable commit yet.
next: Replace in-memory mutable records with append-only commitment log and real audited sensor/request bridge; retain supervision-only initial sample and future values. Independent prelaunch acquisition protocol remains required.
